title: Data Architect
description:
**Your role**
-------------

**About us**
------------

Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873 headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. We are world leaders in Compressors; we also manufacture industrial tools and equipment.


We are an IT Service Provider company within Atlas Copco Group called Global IT Hub (India). We are also focusing on Digital transformation Technologies for Data Driven Decisions, Web and Applications developments, Automations, IT Infrastructure etc.


Data Analytics Competence is the competence within the Global IT Hub (India).


**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Solution Architect to join our growing Data \& Aanlytics team from Digital Technology vertical. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative data solutions that support our data analytics initiatives. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, ensuring our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics.


### **The Role**

* **Bridges the gap:** Translates business needs into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* **Designs the roadmap:** Define and implement scalable, secure data architectures for analytics platforms and BI solutions.
* **Technology expertise:** Possesses deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for optimal performance.
* **Integration champion:** Designs solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing IT infrastructure.
* **Scalability focus:** Keeps scalability and future growth in mind when designing the architecture.
* **Collaboration king:** Works closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure everyone's on the same page.
* **Risk assessment:** Identifies potential risks and proposes solutions to mitigate them.
* **Communication is key:** Clearly communicates complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Innovation:** Stays at part with emerging trends in data and analytics to future\-proof solutions.

**Key responsibilities and accountabilities**
---------------------------------------------

### **Skills and Experience**

* **Data Modelling \& Design:** Expertise in data modelling techniques, including relational (SQL) and non\-relational (NoSQL) databases.
* **Data Warehousing \& ETL:** Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and big data technologies.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in SQL and potentially scripting languages like Python, Spark, etc. for data manipulation and automation.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, Data Bricks, Fabric) for deploying and managing data solutions.
* **Data Management \& Security:** Understanding of data governance, security best practices, and data access controls.
* Certifications: good to have relavent certifications which shows academic regor e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Certified Solution Architect

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

### **Competences**

* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking:** Ability to analyze complex data problems and design effective solutions.
* **Project Management:** Experience managing data\-related projects and ensuring successful execution.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to guide \& collaborate effectively with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams.
* **Strategic thinking** and E **nterprise\-level solution design**

### **Stakeholder management**

* You can discuss with stakeholders about their requirements and clearly communicate back your understanding of the requirements.
* You can work with the stakeholders to understand the big picture and work towards it.
* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.

### **Must have**

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.
* Technology Selection: Deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for specific needs.

### **Nice to have**

* Emerging Technologies: Curiosity and interest in keeping up with emerging data technologies.
* Experience in hybrid environments: cloud \+ on\-prem
* Business Acumen: Understanding of core business processes and how data analytics can drive strategic decision\-making.
* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.
* Mentorship: Ability to mentor and guide junior team members within the data team.

### **Education**

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.

### **Knowledge**

* Good analytical skills: You feel comfortable working with numbers/data, e.g. collecting and analysing trend graphs, combining the info with insights from ERP and previous site visits to come to a sound conclusion.
* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.

### **Personality requirements**

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)
* Open minded; expect the unexpected (\= stay sceptical when viewing at the data and info)
* Not afraid to approach other stakeholders (customer centre specialists, local engineering, or technical support specialists)
* You work with a structured approach when collecting info and data, but also when closing the feedback loop to further increase your learning.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

**What we offer**
-----------------

* This is a leadership role focused on defining roadmap of Data Engineering competence and achieving it.
* Global exposure and opportunities
* This role is ideal for you, if you wish to challenge yourself on Technological front and creating competence centre for Data Engineering and Visualization
* This role gives you enough opportunities to build your professional network among technical fraternity within the group.
* This role also expects you to build a very strong network of local ecosystem and bring the benefits for Atlas Copco
* Flexible working hours
* Flexible office and home working policies
* A modern infrastructure providing you with the latest tools and technologies at your disposal.
* A challenging environment which contributes to your constant learning and professional growth
* To be part of the data competence team which is constantly growing.
* Depending on the country you are enrolled in group healthcare insurance plans covering your medical needs.
* A chance to become part of a global, innovative company, supporting sustainable productivity.
* You get the opportunity to bring revolutionary ideas fostering innovation and execute qualified ideas.
* A friendly culture with immense professional and personal development, education, and opportunities for career growth
* Free access to LinkedIn Learning and many other internal and external trainings
* Atlas Copco offers trainings on a regular basis to acquire new skills.
* You get the opportunity to make the world a better place through our sustainable goals and by contributing and being part of our Water for all projects.
* Friendly and open culture of Swedish company. Very high visibility in the organization with "No door" culture, you can always talk to anyone in the organization.
* Free canteen and transport facility.

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who we're looking for**



Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.


**What you'll be doing**


**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we're looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**


* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
* Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
* Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root\-cause data issues independently
* Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks
* Excellent communication skills — able to present complex data findings clearly to non\-technical business stakeholders
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and how data pipelines work upstream of analytics
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable working across time zones in a globally distributed team


**And if you have any of the following, we** **REALLY** **want you to apply today!**


* Experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to GTM, Finance, or R\&D data
* Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and data structures
* Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
* Prior experience supporting executive\-level reporting or board\-level dashboards
* Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus


**Why Fieldwire?**



The field\-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M\+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real\-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.


**Where is the job located?**



This role is hybrid in Pune, India.


*Monday \& Friday: WFH* *2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*


*Tuesday\-Thursday \- 1**2:00 PM–8:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*


* *\-*


*Fieldwire is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*
